pages.title: Totoro Exploring in Countryside Field Coloring Page
pages.description: Totoro explores a countryside field on this printable coloring page, carrying an open umbrella as he follows a winding path through grassy rolling hills. A small house, fence, and rows of trees sit below distant mountain peaks, while flowers and scattered stones line the foreground around his steps.

pages.title: Totoro Walking Slowly Near Village Path Coloring Page
pages.description: Totoro walks slowly along a village path on this printable coloring page, wearing a leaf on his head as the road winds between wooden fences. A cottage with a smoking chimney stands behind him, and flowers, trees, distant houses, and rounded hills fill the surrounding rural scene.

pages.title: Totoro Jumping in Forest Clearing Coloring Page
pages.description: Totoro jumps in a forest clearing on this printable coloring page, raising both paws and opening his mouth above a small mound of leaves and soil. Motion lines and flying pebbles mark the leap, while tall trunks, bushes, and broad leaves form a leafy frame around him.

pages.title: Totoro Exploring in Peaceful Garden Coloring Page
pages.description: Totoro explores a peaceful garden on this printable coloring page, carrying a small bag and holding a large leaf over his head beside a winding path. A snail rests on a nearby stone, while tulips, other flowers, a potted plant, and an arched garden gate surround his walk.

pages.title: Totoro Standing Confidently in Forest Clearing Coloring Page
pages.description: Totoro stands confidently in a forest clearing on this printable coloring page, holding both paws against his patterned belly beneath a small closed smile. Tall tree trunks and oversized leaves frame his pointed ears, while mushrooms, low shrubs, stones, and tufts of grass fill the ground around him.

pages.title: Totoro Waving Near Small Pond Coloring Page
pages.description: Totoro waves beside a small pond on this printable coloring page, lifting one paw while standing near lily pads and clumps of tall water plants. His broad belly fills the center of the scene, with rounded rocks at the bank and a few trees across the rolling background.

pages.title: Totoro Standing Calmly Under Giant Tree Coloring Page
pages.description: Totoro stands calmly beneath a giant tree on this printable coloring page, smiling with closed eyes in front of its wide trunk and spreading roots. Branches and leafy clusters fill the upper half of the scene, while simple grass tufts surround his feet and large patterned belly.

pages.title: Totoro Waving Under Giant Tree Coloring Page
pages.description: Totoro waves under a giant tree on this printable coloring page, smiling broadly beneath a canopy of many leaves and hanging acorns above his ears. Exposed roots reach across the ground behind him, with flowers in the foreground and small birds and clouds over the distant trees.

pages.title: Totoro Exploring in Nature Trail Coloring Page
pages.description: Totoro explores a nature trail on this printable coloring page, using a walking stick and carrying a small shoulder bag beneath a leaf on his head. The path bends between trees and shrubs, with ferns, flowers, stones, and fallen leaves adding detail around his steady walking pose.

pages.title: Totoro Walking in Nature Trail Coloring Page
pages.description: Totoro walks along a nature trail on this printable coloring page, holding an open umbrella beside his head as the path curves through tall trees. His lifted foot and rounded tail stand out against the winding track, while flowers, rocks, shrubs, and broad leaves line its grassy edges.

pages.title: Totoro Observing in Nature Trail Coloring Page
pages.description: Totoro observes the woodland beside a nature trail on this printable coloring page, holding a small bunch of leaves while turning his gaze toward nearby plants. A blank arrow sign stands farther up the winding path, with tree trunks, ferns, loose leaves, and stones filling the surrounding forest.

pages.title: Totoro Thinking in Nature Trail Coloring Page
pages.description: Totoro thinks on a nature trail on this printable coloring page, sitting with one paw at his chin and a leafy sprig against his belly. His feet extend onto the path between ferns and stones, while trees, bushes, and distant hills surround the quiet woodland scene.
